newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish bond prices rise, market seen calm.
newsitem.headline: Danish bond prices rise, market seen calm.

text.p: Danish bond prices rose in early trade on Tuesday with dealers expecting sentiment to remain positive throughout a calm trading day.
At 0715 GMT the benchmark eight percent state bond due 2006 stood at 110.76, yielding 6.35 percent, up 0.26 point from Monday's close.
The seven percent 2007 bond traded at 103.32, yielding 6.54 percent, up from around 103.00 at close of business on Monday.
The 2006 benchmark's yield gap with Germany narrowed to 45 basis points from Monday's 48 bp and the 2007 gap to the bund also closed by three basis point to 64 bp.
The crown firmed slightly to 3.8076 per mark compared to 3.8079 at midday on Monday.
The six percent mortgage bond due 2026 was up 0.18 point to 88.88. --Steve Weizman, Copenhagen newsroom, 45-33-969650
